author: DamiLee
description:
In India, living root bridges are grown over decades by guiding fig tree roots into flexible, self-repairing structures. This ancient technique reveals how a city like Lothlórien-suspended in trees and moving with nature-might actually work. Could nature-inspired architecture be the future of design? 🌲🌱🌳

#LivingArchitecture #RootBridges #Lothlorien #BiophilicDesign #FantasyMeetsReality
title: Could Lothlórien exist in India? Living root bridges explained
